houses_time_zone_revision_pair_check.name: houses_time_zone_revision_pair_check
houses_time_zone_revision_pair_check.value: ("houses"."time_zone" IS NULL AND "houses"."time_zone_revision" IS NULL) OR "houses"."time_zone_revision" IS NOT NULL

meal_plan_migration_conflicts_resolution.name: meal_plan_migration_conflicts_resolution_check
meal_plan_migration_conflicts_resolution.value:
("meal_plan_migration_conflicts"."status" = 'pending' AND "meal_plan_migration_conflicts"."resolution_digest" IS NULL AND "meal_plan_migration_conflicts"."resolution_command" IS NULL
      AND "meal_plan_migration_conflicts"."resolution_result" IS NULL AND "meal_plan_migration_conflicts"."resolved_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "meal_plan_migration_conflicts"."resolved_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("meal_plan_migration_conflicts"."status" = 'resolved' AND "meal_plan_migration_conflicts"."resolution_digest" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
      AND "meal_plan_migration_conflicts"."resolution_command" IS NOT NULL AND "meal_plan_migration_conflicts"."resolution_result" IS NOT NULL
      AND "meal_plan_migration_conflicts"."resolved_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "meal_plan_migration_conflicts"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

meal_plan_receipts_scope_check.name: meal_plan_receipts_scope_check
meal_plan_receipts_scope_check.value: ("meal_plan_receipts"."scope_type" = 'user' AND "meal_plan_receipts"."user_scope_id" IS NOT NULL AND "meal_plan_receipts"."house_scope_id" IS NULL AND "meal_plan_receipts"."scope_id" = "meal_plan_receipts"."user_scope_id"::text) OR ("meal_plan_receipts"."scope_type" = 'house' AND "meal_plan_receipts"."user_scope_id" IS NULL AND "meal_plan_receipts"."house_scope_id" IS NOT NULL AND "meal_plan_receipts"."scope_id" = "meal_plan_receipts"."house_scope_id"::text)

meal_plan_receipts_import_provenance_che.name: meal_plan_receipts_import_provenance_check
meal_plan_receipts_import_provenance_che.value: ("meal_plan_receipts"."import_source" IS NULL AND "meal_plan_receipts"."import_source_id" IS NULL AND "meal_plan_receipts"."import_local_revision" IS NULL AND "meal_plan_receipts"."command_hash" IS NULL) OR ("meal_plan_receipts"."import_source" IS NOT NULL AND "meal_plan_receipts"."import_source" IN ('guest', 'account') AND "meal_plan_receipts"."import_source_id" IS NOT NULL AND length("meal_plan_receipts"."import_source_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND "meal_plan_receipts"."import_local_revision" IS NOT NULL AND length("meal_plan_receipts"."import_local_revision") BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND "meal_plan_receipts"."command_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "meal_plan_receipts"."command_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

meal_plan_states_scope_check.name: meal_plan_states_scope_check
meal_plan_states_scope_check.value: ("meal_plan_states"."scope_type" = 'user' AND "meal_plan_states"."user_scope_id" IS NOT NULL AND "meal_plan_states"."house_scope_id" IS NULL AND "meal_plan_states"."scope_id" = "meal_plan_states"."user_scope_id"::text) OR ("meal_plan_states"."scope_type" = 'house' AND "meal_plan_states"."user_scope_id" IS NULL AND "meal_plan_states"."house_scope_id" IS NOT NULL AND "meal_plan_states"."scope_id" = "meal_plan_states"."house_scope_id"::text)

meal_plan_states_recipe_check.name: meal_plan_states_recipe_check
meal_plan_states_recipe_check.value: ("meal_plan_states"."kind" = 'deleted' AND "meal_plan_states"."recipe_id" IS NULL) OR ("meal_plan_states"."kind" IN ('automatic', 'manual') AND "meal_plan_states"."recipe_id" IS NOT NULL)

meal_plan_states_manual_tuple_check.name: meal_plan_states_manual_tuple_check
meal_plan_states_manual_tuple_check.value: ("meal_plan_states"."manual_client_at" IS NULL AND "meal_plan_states"."manual_server_at" IS NULL AND "meal_plan_states"."manual_device_id" IS NULL AND "meal_plan_states"."manual_operation_id" IS NULL) OR ("meal_plan_states"."manual_client_at" IS NOT NULL AND "meal_plan_states"."manual_server_at" IS NOT NULL AND "meal_plan_states"."manual_device_id" IS NOT NULL AND "meal_plan_states"."manual_operation_id" IS NOT NULL)
